newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan oil basket falls $1.15 to $20.25 in wk.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan oil basket falls $1.15 to $20.25 in wk.

text.p: The average export price for Venezuela's basket of crude and products fell $1.15 to $20.25 on Friday, compared to $21.40 on Sept 13, the Energy and Mines Ministry said.
The average price for the year so far is $17.36 per barrel, the ministry statement said.
Venezuela's oil export price averaged $14.84 per barrel last year compared to $13.23 per barrel in 1994.
The Venezuelan government has based its recently revised 1996 budget calculations on an average price of $17.00 per barrel.
